description: This PHP source file defines the class MyInfoMenuConfigurator which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It is responsible for configuring a menu item labeled 'My Info' by fetching it from the menu service. The class resides within the OrangeHRM application's PIM menu plugin package and uses traits and classes specific to OrangeHRM's core and entity structures.

classes.name: MyInfoMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for the 'My Info' menu item within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. Uses dependency injection via traits to access menu services.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Fetches and returns the menu item with title 'My Info' for the given screen, if available.
